keyVerseDR: "Lord, to whom shall we go? Thou hast the words of eternal life." (Jn 6:69 DR)

level1.title: Peter Stays With Jesus
level1.story: Some followers said, "This teaching is hard!" and left Jesus. Jesus asked the Twelve, "Will you also go away?" Peter said, "Lord, to whom shall we go?"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How can you stay close to Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I will always stay with You. Amen.

activity.title: I will stay with Jesus
activity.intro: Put your thumbprint on the cross as a promise.
activity.label: I stay with Jesus

level2.title: To Whom Shall We Go?
level2.story: Many of Jesus' disciples said, "This saying is hard, and who can hear it?" Jesus said, "It is the spirit that quickeneth; the words that I have spoken to you, are spirit and life." After this, many of His disciples went back and walked no more with Him. Jesus asked the Twelve, "Will you also go away?" Simon Peter answered, "Lord, to whom shall we go? Thou hast the words of eternal life."
level2.keyLine: Lord, to whom shall we go? Thou hast the words of eternal life.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: When is it hard to follow Jesus?
level2.prayer: Lord, You have the words of eternal life. Amen.
